section: ISRO - organisational structure, major centres and their functions
subsections: SDSC-SHAR Sriharikota (AP) - district, lake, launch pads, gallery, third launch pad
ISRO centres - full form, location, function

accepted.s: Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC-SHAR) was originally established in 1971 under which name?
accepted.x: SDSC-SHAR was established in 1971 as the Sriharikota High Altitude Range (SHAR). It was renamed in 2002 after former ISRO Chairman Satish Dhawan.
accepted.tq: Test the original name against the later renamed identity.
accepted.sec: SDSC-SHAR Sriharikota (AP) - district, lake, launch pads, gallery, third launch pad  [APPSC]

accepted.s: In which year was Sriharikota High Altitude Range renamed as Satish Dhawan Space Centre?
accepted.x: The centre was renamed Satish Dhawan Space Centre in 2002 in honour of former ISRO Chairman Satish Dhawan.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the establishment year from the renaming year.
accepted.sec: SDSC-SHAR Sriharikota (AP) - district, lake, launch pads, gallery, third launch pad  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Sriharikota barrier island is situated between which of the following?
o: Kolleru Lake and the Arabian Sea
Pulicat Lake and the Bay of Bengal
Chilika Lake and the Indian Ocean
Vembanad Lake and the Bay of Bengal
accepted.x: Sriharikota lies between Pulicat Lake to the west and the Bay of Bengal to the east.
accepted.tq: Use the east-west geographical relationship to separate nearby coastal locations.
accepted.sec: SDSC-SHAR Sriharikota (AP) - district, lake, launch pads, gallery, third launch pad  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Public Launch View Gallery at Sriharikota was opened in:
accepted.x: The Public Launch View Gallery at Sriharikota was opened in 2019 for viewing rocket launches.
accepted.tq: Test a precise year associated with a public facility.
accepted.sec: SDSC-SHAR Sriharikota (AP) - district, lake, launch pads, gallery, third launch pad  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: First launch pad — GSLV and LVM3
Second launch pad — PSLV and SSLV
First launch pad — PSLV and SSLV
Third launch pad — operational launch of PSLV-C62
accepted.x: The first launch pad is used for PSLV and SSLV missions. The second launch pad is associated with GSLV and LVM3, while the third launch pad was approved for future use.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure vehicle-to-launch-pad association.
accepted.sec: SDSC-SHAR Sriharikota (AP) - district, lake, launch pads, gallery, third launch pad  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Third Launch Pad at Sriharikota was approved by the Union Cabinet in:
accepted.x: The Union Cabinet approved the Third Launch Pad in January 2025.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact approval year rather than the proposed-use year.
accepted.sec: SDSC-SHAR Sriharikota (AP) - district, lake, launch pads, gallery, third launch pad  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The approximate estimated cost of the Third Launch Pad at Sriharikota is:
accepted.x: The Third Launch Pad has an estimated cost of about ₹4,000 crore.
accepted.tq: Test the quantitative figure using nearby but distinct cost values.
accepted.sec: SDSC-SHAR Sriharikota (AP) - district, lake, launch pads, gallery, third launch pad  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Third Launch Pad is primarily intended to support which of the following?
o: NGLV and future human spaceflight missions
accepted.x: The Third Launch Pad is planned for the Next Generation Launch Vehicle (NGLV) and future human spaceflight missions.
accepted.tq: Match the proposed infrastructure with its intended operational use.
accepted.sec: SDSC-SHAR Sriharikota (AP) - district, lake, launch pads, gallery, third launch pad  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT a reason supporting the selection of Sriharikota as a launch site?
o: Launches can proceed eastward over the sea.
The area is thinly populated and permits safe fall of spent stages.
The location benefits from the Earth's rotation.
It is located close to the northern polar region.
accepted.x: Sriharikota was selected because of its east-coast location, proximity to the equator, sea corridor for spent stages and relatively thin population. It is not close to the northern polar region.
accepted.tq: Find the geographically incompatible location statement.
accepted.sec: SDSC-SHAR Sriharikota (AP) - district, lake, launch pads, gallery, third launch pad  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Solid Propellant Space Booster Plant (SPROB) at SDSC-SHAR is associated with the casting of which boosters?
o: Solid motors of sounding rockets only
accepted.x: SPROB is a major solid-propellant plant that casts the S200 boosters used in LVM3.
accepted.tq: Match the plant function with the specific booster designation.
accepted.sec: SDSC-SHAR Sriharikota (AP) - district, lake, launch pads, gallery, third launch pad  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
o: MCF — assembly of liquid and cryogenic engines
NARL — atmospheric radar, lidar and monsoon dynamics
SDSC-SHAR — reception and distribution of satellite data
accepted.x: NARL at Gadanki is an autonomous Department of Space research body concerned with atmospheric radar, lidar and monsoon dynamics. The other functions belong to different ISRO centres.
accepted.tq: Use function-based elimination among specialised centres.
accepted.sec: SDSC-SHAR Sriharikota (AP) - district, lake, launch pads, gallery, third launch pad  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The National Atmospheric Research Laboratory (NARL) is located at:
accepted.x: NARL is located at Gadanki in Tirupati and conducts research on atmospheric radar, lidar and monsoon dynamics.
accepted.tq: Test the location of a specialised research body against ISRO centre locations.
accepted.sec: SDSC-SHAR Sriharikota (AP) - district, lake, launch pads, gallery, third launch pad  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which ISRO centre is the lead centre for launch-vehicle design and development?
accepted.x: The Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC), located at Thiruvananthapuram, is the lead centre for launch-vehicle design and development.
accepted.tq: Identify the centre from its distinctive core function.
accepted.sec: ISRO centres - full form, location, function  [APPSC]

accepted.s: VSSC is located at:
accepted.x: Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre is located at Thiruvananthapuram.
accepted.tq: Separate centre headquarters from similarly named ISRO facilities.
accepted.sec: ISRO centres - full form, location, function  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following centres is responsible for liquid and cryogenic stages?
accepted.x: The Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre (LPSC), with units at Valiamala and Bengaluru, develops liquid and cryogenic stages.
accepted.tq: Match the propulsion function with the correct centre abbreviation.
accepted.sec: ISRO centres - full form, location, function  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. LPSC — Valiamala and Bengaluru
2. IPRC — Mahendragiri
3. SAC — Ahmedabad
4. NRSC — Hyderabad
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: All four pairs are correctly matched. LPSC has units at Valiamala and Bengaluru, IPRC is at Mahendragiri, SAC at Ahmedabad and NRSC at Hyderabad.
accepted.tq: Verify multiple centre-location pairs before selecting the complete combination.
accepted.sec: ISRO centres - full form, location, function  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC) at Mahendragiri is mainly concerned with:
o: Assembly and testing of liquid and cryogenic engines and stages
accepted.x: IPRC at Mahendragiri is responsible for assembly and testing of liquid and cryogenic engines and stages. Mahendragiri is in Tamil Nadu, not Kerala.
accepted.tq: Use the centre's specialised technical activity to reject swapped functions.
accepted.sec: ISRO centres - full form, location, function  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements about URSC is correct?
1. URSC stands for U R Rao Satellite Centre.
2. It was earlier known as ISAC.
3. It is located in Bengaluru and is concerned with satellite design and building.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. URSC is the U R Rao Satellite Centre, formerly ISAC, located in Bengaluru and responsible for satellite design and building.
accepted.tq: Check the abbreviation, former name and function as one centre profile.
accepted.sec: ISRO centres - full form, location, function  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Space Applications Centre (SAC) at Ahmedabad is primarily associated with:
accepted.x: SAC at Ahmedabad develops payloads for communication and remote sensing and undertakes applications research.
accepted.tq: Match the applications-oriented function with SAC.
accepted.sec: ISRO centres - full form, location, function  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which centre receives, processes and distributes satellite data?
accepted.x: The National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC), located at Hyderabad, handles satellite data reception, processing and distribution.
accepted.tq: Identify the data-chain function rather than a launch or propulsion function.
accepted.sec: ISRO centres - full form, location, function  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Human Space Flight Centre (HSFC) is located at Bengaluru and is associated with which programme?
accepted.x: HSFC is located at Bengaluru and is responsible for the Gaganyaan programme.
accepted.tq: Link the institutional centre with its flagship programme.
accepted.sec: ISRO centres - full form, location, function  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. MCF controls geostationary satellites.
2. MCF has facilities at Hassan and Bhopal.
3. ISTRAC is located at Bengaluru and tracks launch vehicles and satellites.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. MCF operates from Hassan and Bhopal for geostationary-satellite control, while ISTRAC at Bengaluru performs tracking, telemetry and command functions.
accepted.tq: Distinguish satellite control by MCF from tracking by ISTRAC.
accepted.sec: ISRO centres - full form, location, function  [APPSC]

accepted.s: What is the full form of ISTRAC?
o: Indian Space Telemetry and Remote Applications Centre
ISRO Satellite Tracking and Research Centre
ISRO Telemetry, Tracking and Command Network
ISRO Technical Research and Communications Centre
accepted.x: ISTRAC stands for ISRO Telemetry, Tracking and Command Network.
accepted.tq: Discriminate the exact official expansion from look-alike expansions.
accepted.sec: ISRO centres - full form, location, function  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below.

List-I (Centre)
a. VSSC
b. URSC
c. NRSC
d. ISTRAC

List-II (Function)
i. Satellite design and building
ii. Tracking launch vehicles and satellites
iii. Launch-vehicle design and development
iv. Satellite data reception, processing and distribution

Codes:
accepted.x: VSSC handles launch-vehicle design and development; URSC handles satellite design and building; NRSC handles satellite data; ISTRAC tracks launch vehicles and satellites.
accepted.tq: Start with the distinctive VSSC and ISTRAC functions, then complete the code.
accepted.sec: ISRO centres - full form, location, function  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: IPRC — Mahendragiri — engine and stage testing
SDSC-SHAR — Sriharikota — launch base and solid motor production
MCF — Hassan and Bhopal — control of geostationary satellites
NRSC — Hyderabad — launch-vehicle design and development
accepted.x: NRSC at Hyderabad handles satellite data reception, processing and remote-sensing applications. Launch-vehicle design and development is the function of VSSC.
accepted.tq: Find the wrong function attached to a correctly identified centre and location.
accepted.sec: ISRO centres - full form, location, function  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Arrange the following events in chronological order:
A. Establishment of Sriharikota High Altitude Range
B. Renaming of SHAR as Satish Dhawan Space Centre
C. Opening of the Public Launch View Gallery
D. Approval of the Third Launch Pad
accepted.x: SHAR was established in 1971, renamed in 2002, the Public Launch View Gallery opened in 2019, and the Third Launch Pad was approved in January 2025.
accepted.tq: Fix the first and last events, then place the intermediate dates.
accepted.sec: SDSC-SHAR Sriharikota (AP) - district, lake, launch pads, gallery, third launch pad  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Sriharikota recorded its 100th launch on 29 January 2025. This was the:
o: 105th launch from the first launch pad
107th launch from the second launch pad
accepted.x: The 100th launch from Sriharikota occurred on 29 January 2025 and was the 17th GSLV flight.
accepted.tq: Separate the total launch milestone from the vehicle-flight count.
accepted.sec: SDSC-SHAR Sriharikota (AP) - district, lake, launch pads, gallery, third launch pad  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the launch milestones given for Sriharikota?
o: GSLV-F17/EOS-05 was the 105th launch on 4 September 2026 from the first launch pad.
GSLV-F17/EOS-05 was launched on 29 January 2025 as the 100th launch.
The 100th launch occurred on 12 January 2026 and used the second launch pad.
PSLV-C62/EOS-N1 was the 105th launch on 12 January 2026 from the first launch pad.
accepted.x: PSLV-C62/EOS-N1 launched on 12 January 2026 and marked the 105th launch from Sriharikota from the first launch pad. GSLV-F17/EOS-05 was the 107th launch on 4 September 2026 from the second launch pad.
accepted.tq: Compare close milestone numbers, dates and launch-pad identifiers.
accepted.sec: SDSC-SHAR Sriharikota (AP) - district, lake, launch pads, gallery, third launch pad  [APPSC]

accepted.s: GSLV-F17/EOS-05, launched on 4 September 2026, marked which milestone?
o: The 107th launch from the second launch pad
The first launch from the Third Launch Pad
The 105th launch from the first launch pad
accepted.x: GSLV-F17/EOS-05 was the 107th launch from Sriharikota and was conducted from the second launch pad. It was not a launch from the proposed Third Launch Pad.
accepted.tq: Match the mission designation with its exact date and milestone number.
accepted.sec: SDSC-SHAR Sriharikota (AP) - district, lake, launch pads, gallery, third launch pad  [APPSC]
